14.t: Working with data: what the kidneys do
q: Which substances are in plasma but not in urine?
How many times more concentrated is urea in urine than in plasma?
Explain why there is no protein in urine.
Protein molecules are too large to be filtered out of the blood in the kidney.
Glucose is filtered but none is in the urine. Explain what happens to it, and what glucose in urine might suggest.
All glucose is reabsorbed back into the blood. Glucose in urine suggests diabetes: there is too much to reabsorb.
